*User Story:*

As a developer, I want to connect the database to the backend so that the application can store, retrieve, update, and manage data efficiently.

*Scope:*

* Establish a connection between the backend application and the database.
* Configure database connection credentials and environment variables securely.
* Implement database connection and disconnection handling.
* Enable backend services to execute database queries.
* Handle database connection failures and query errors.
* Verify that the backend can successfully communicate with the database.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

# The backend successfully connects to the configured database.
# Database credentials are stored securely and are not hardcoded into the source code.
# The backend can insert and retrieve data from the database.
# Database errors are handled appropriately without crashing the application.
# The application manages database connections correctly.
# Database operations are tested and verified.
# The database integration works with the application's existing backend functionality.

As a new user, I want a registration page where I can enter my account details so that I can register for the application.

Scope:

* Design the registration page layout.
* Add the required registration fields, such as name, email, and password.
* Add a Register or Create Account button.
* Include input validation and error message areas.
* Add a link to the login page.
* Make the page responsive for desktop and mobile devices.

Acceptance Criteria:

# The page displays all required registration fields.
# Each field has a clear label.
# Required fields are validated before submission.
# Invalid input receives appropriate feedback.
# A link to the login page is available.
# The layout works on desktop and mobile screens.
# The interface can be connected to the Create User functionality.

As a registered user, I want a simple and user-friendly login page so that I can enter my credentials and access the application.

Scope:

* Design the login page layout.
* Add email or username and password fields.
* Add a Login button.
* Include input validation and error message areas.
* Add a link to the registration page.
* Make the page responsive for desktop and mobile devices.

Acceptance Criteria:

# The page displays the required login fields.
# Each field has a clear label.
# The Login button is visible and usable.
# Empty or invalid inputs receive appropriate feedback.
# A link to the registration page is available.
# The layout works on desktop and mobile screens.
# The interface can be connected to the User Login functionality.

As a user, I want a clear and user-friendly home page so that I can easily navigate the application's main features.

Scope:

* Design the home page layout.
* Display the application name or logo.
* Add navigation links to the main sections.
* Include appropriate buttons and links.
* Make the page responsive for desktop and mobile devices.

Acceptance Criteria:

# The home page displays the application name or logo.
# Navigation elements are clearly visible.
# Buttons and links are appropriately positioned.
# The layout adapts to desktop and mobile screen sizes.
# The page follows the agreed design.
# Navigation links direct users to the appropriate pages when available.

As a registered user, I want to log in using my credentials so that I can securely access the application.

Acceptance Criteria:

# Users can log in using valid credentials.
# Invalid credentials are rejected.
# An appropriate error message is displayed when login fails.
# Passwords are verified securely.
# Successful login establishes an authenticated session or token.
# Unauthenticated users cannot access protected features.

As a new user, I want to create an account so that I can access the application's features.

Acceptance Criteria:

# The system accepts valid user registration details.
# Required fields are validated.
# A user account is created when the submitted details are valid.
# Duplicate accounts are rejected with an appropriate error message.
# Passwords are stored securely using password hashing.
# Invalid registration requests return meaningful error messages.
